description: Sub-GB AUZiX netinstall/live media profile: boot, network, SSH, install a base root, then hydrate package groups from the AUZiX repository. This intentionally excludes the workstation and demo desktop payload.

size_budget.notes: The ISO may include kernel, initramfs, live SquashFS, boot assets, installer-core packages, and receipts. Desktop, office, Flatpak apps, screenshots, wallpaper packs, Podman demo images, and large themes are post-install package groups.

mirrored_concepts: profile package lists drive media contents
logs and receipts record every build/install decision
kernel and bootloader are boot substrate, not ordinary desktop packages
not_mirrored: stuffing dependency closure by hand into the profile

boot_substrate.purpose: Make the media boot and become remotely diagnosable.
contents: matching kernel modules required for storage, ISO, SquashFS, overlay, virtio/e1000/vmxnet networking
live SquashFS mount and tmpfs overlay handoff

required_bootstrap_actions: write repository config into installed root
refresh package index before group install
verify package archive checksums before extraction

acceptance: DHCP obtains IPv4 or a declared static config is applied
resolver path exists and can resolve the AUZiX repo host or documented IP fallback
sshd starts before any GUI/installer UI
root key login succeeds or the selected lab password profile is explicitly declared
TTY or serial shell is available even when graphical installer startup fails

install_flow: Mount ISO and AUZiX live SquashFS read-only.
Bring up proc, sysfs, devtmpfs/devpts, tmpfs runtime mounts, and network.
Start sshd and write a boot receipt.
Operator or installer selects target disk.
Partition, format ext4, mount installed root.
Install AUZiX base root and package tools.
Install selected package groups such as AuzixDesktopBase, AuzixOffice, AuzixContainerHost.

media_static: BIOS and UEFI boot entries are present unless the build is explicitly labelled BIOS-only
ISO size is below the hard fail budget
boot_smoke: VM boots to shell/installer spine without starting a desktop
ip addr shows an active non-loopback interface
ssh root@target succeeds through the selected access profile
auzix-pkg refresh reaches the configured repository
mkfs.ext4, parted, mount, df, du, strace, and file are present
explicit_non_goals: No LightDM/E/GUI acceptance in this profile
No LibreOffice/Flatpak/Podman demo acceptance in this profile

promotion_rule: This profile can be promoted only when a disposable VM can be booted and reached by SSH before any workstation package group is installed.
